description: The aggregate report of one aratame inspection run over a repo@ref under an InspectionMandate. executedCode is a structural const false enforcing the STATIC-ONLY ceiling (G3): aratame never ran the inspected code. nonAdjudicating const true (G8): the report is evidence, not a verdict. Aggregate-first surface (counts) with findingCids[] referencing the individual com.etzhayyim.aratame.vulnFinding records. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of report emit.

toolVersions.description: Pinned OSS scanner name@version used this run (G5 provenance).

countsBySeverity.description: JSON object string of severity → count (info/low/medium/high/critical). Aggregate-first.

findingCids.description: CIDs of the individual com.etzhayyim.aratame.vulnFinding records emitted this run.

executedCode.description: G3: structurally false. aratame performed STATIC analysis only — it never executed / ran / fuzzed the inspected code.

nonAdjudicating.description: G8: structurally true. The report is evidence / an accountability+resilience map, not a verdict or exploitation target-list.

remediationHandoffActor.description: G13: actor the findings are handed to for propose-only remediation (did:web:tsukuroi.etzhayyim.com). aratame never patches.

inferenceProvenance.description: G10: Murakumo judah LiteLLM provenance for the triage_synthesis pass (model gemma4-26b-a4b); no vendor API.
